en: A colorized historic postcard view of a domed mosque with a single tall minaret in a hilly urban area. The foreground shows a dirt path, stone walls, and small houses with red roofs; a few people walk on the path. The mosque has multiple domes and arched windows. Printed captions at the top read in French about Constantinople and the Kahrieh Mosque, and there is a web address watermark at the bottom right.
